title: Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM) — Institutional Investment Monograph & Action Plan
primer: Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM) is an asset-light semiconductor and patent-licensing leader earning a 31.13% ROIC. The company is pivoting from Apple modems toward Automotive ($6.00B), IoT ($7.13B), and Data Center AI ($5.0B FY27 target) [1, 5, 6]. At $172.47 (14.24x forward P/E), shares remain in a Stage 3 pullback (screened AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN) below the 50-day ($178.73) and 30-week ($184.35) averages [23, 24]. We hold 30 existing shares with a $150.07 hard stop and wait for $152.37–$157.01 support before adding new capital.
holding_rationale: Hold all 30.0 existing shares across Charles Schwab (15.0) and Robinhood (15.0). Total cost basis is $4,868.78 ($162.29 per share) against $5,174.10 market value at $172.47. That leaves a +$305.32 unrealized gain and a balanced 5.83% portfolio weight above the $170.20 200D SMA. Do not panic-sell into this 33.6% drawdown; protect capital with a hard stop below $150.07 and watch bounces into $181.92–$184.35.

Trim or re-evaluate 15.0 shares if QCOM rallies into the $181.92–$184.35 resistance ceiling and rejects on weak volume.
